basis: source tree at commit 571631acf538689731a0549d326cd36fab98974e (main, 2026-10-20; VERSION_NAME 1.5.0, versionCode 11) + docs https://github.com/FossifyOrg/Camera/blob/571631acf538689731a0549d326cd36fab98974e/README.md and fastlane en-US store listing

features.name: Shutter
features.what: Takes a photo in Photo mode; starts/stops recording in Video mode (animated record icon)

features.name: Photo / Video tabs
features.what: Tab strip to switch between photo and video capture; also switchable by swiping left/right on the tab strip

features.name: Photo mode
features.what: Still capture mode

features.name: Video mode
features.what: Video recording mode with audio (microphone optional)

features.name: Recording timer
features.what: Shows elapsed time while a video is recording
features.match_note: elapsed time drawn inside the shutter button (ShutterAnimationHandler); no census entry

features.name: Toggle front/back camera
features.what: Switches between rear and front camera

features.name: View last captured media
features.what: Thumbnail of the last photo/video; tap opens it in an external viewer/gallery app (no built-in gallery)
features.match_note: gallery button thumbnail opens GlassCam's own viewer

features.name: Flash mode
features.what: Top-bar button opening a picker: Off, Auto, On, Always on (torch)

features.name: Timer mode
features.what: Self-timer picker: Off, 3 s, 5 s, 10 s; countdown shown on screen with beeps, cancellable by tapping the shutter

features.name: Change resolution
features.what: Top-bar picker for the active camera's sizes: photo aspect presets (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, full screen) or video quality (SD, HD, FHD, UHD)
features.match_note: video quality via setting:VIDEO_PROFILES

features.name: Settings button
features.what: Opens the settings screen from the camera top bar

features.name: Tap to focus
features.what: Single tap on the preview sets focus and exposure point; a focus circle is drawn
features.match_note: touch on the preview sets focus and metering area (FocusImageHandler); no census entry

features.name: Pinch to zoom
features.what: Two-finger pinch on the preview changes zoom ratio within the camera's range
features.match_note: zoom only through the manual-strip slider; no gesture zoom on the preview

features.name: Icon rotation with device orientation
features.what: UI is portrait-locked but control icons rotate to match how the phone is held
features.match_note: GlassCam's UI is locked to landscape; controls do not rotate

features.name: Hardware camera button
features.what: Device camera key triggers the shutter
features.match_note: camera key and headset hook start capture (KeyPressedController); no census entry

features.name: Show on lock screen
features.what: Camera can open over the lock screen (secure capture intents)

features.name: Customize colors
features.what: Fossify theme/colour customization screen (text, background, primary colour, app icon colour)
features.match_note: no light/dark or colour theme choice (only the red night overlay)

features.name: App launcher icon colour
features.what: Choice of launcher icon colour (19 colour variants via activity aliases), set through Customize colors
features.match_note: no launcher icon choice

features.name: Use English language
features.what: Forces English UI regardless of system language (shown on some systems)
features.match_note: no in-app language choice; follows the system

features.name: Language
features.what: Opens per-app language selection
features.match_note: no in-app language choice; follows the system

features.name: Shutter sound
features.what: Toggle shutter/recording sound

features.name: Use volume buttons as shutter
features.what: Volume up/down act as the shutter
features.match_note: volume keys step the active manual control; only the camera key / headset hook fire the shutter (KeyPressedController, no census entry)

features.name: Max screen brightness in preview
features.what: Raises screen brightness to maximum while the camera preview is open
features.match_note: no screen-brightness control

features.name: Save photo exif metadata
features.what: Toggle whether EXIF metadata is written to photos
features.match_note: EXIF is always written; only geotagging can be turned off

features.name: Save photo and video location
features.what: Geotag photos and videos (requests location permission)
features.match_note: geotag documented for photos only; video location not confirmed

features.name: Flip front camera photos horizontally
features.what: Mirror (un-mirror) selfies on save
features.match_note: no option to mirror front-camera photos

features.name: Save photos and videos to
features.what: Folder picker for the save location (internal or SD card via SAF)

features.name: Photo compression quality
features.what: JPEG quality from 50% to 100% in 5% steps

features.name: Capture mode
features.what: Choose Maximize quality or Minimize latency for photo capture
features.match_note: quality-vs-speed set piecemeal (capture template, noise reduction, edge modes); no single switch; ZSL is Camera1-only

features.name: About / FAQ
features.what: About screen with app info and FAQ (e.g. which compression quality to choose)
features.match_note: help overlay explains controls; no About/FAQ screen

features.name: More Fossify apps
features.what: Overflow menu link to other Fossify apps
features.match_note: no links to other apps

features.name: Custom fonts
features.what: Support for custom fonts (CHANGELOG 1.5.0; the picker lives in the Fossify Commons library, not in this repo, so its exact location is unverified)
features.match_note: no font choice

features.name: Image capture intent
features.what: Other apps can request a photo (IMAGE_CAPTURE / _SECURE, honours EXTRA_OUTPUT); mode tabs hidden

features.name: Video capture intent
features.what: Other apps can request a video (VIDEO_CAPTURE)
features.match_note: VIDEO_CAPTURE is not handled; other apps cannot ask GlassCam for a video

features.name: Still / video camera launch intents
features.what: Responds to STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA(_SECURE) and VIDEO_CAMERA (e.g. double-press power, lock-screen shortcut)
features.match_note: STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA(_SECURE) handled; VIDEO_CAMERA not

features.name: App preferences intent
features.what: Settings reachable from the system app-info screen (APPLICATION_PREFERENCES)
features.match_note: no APPLICATION_PREFERENCES entry

notes: No widgets or quick-settings tiles. No built-in gallery: the thumbnail hands off to an external viewer. strings.xml still defines 'Show a photo preview after capturing', 'Focus before capture', 'Keep the setting buttons visible', 'Always open the app with the Back camera' and 'Turn flash off at startup', but none appears in activity_settings.xml or SettingsActivity.kt at this commit, so they are not listed as features.
